body.p: Applicant thanks Examiner Redhead and Primary Examiner Trivedi for the courtesy of a telephone interview on August 6, 2024. The interview summary mailed by the USPTO on August 9, 2024, accurately reflects the sum and substance of the interview.

The claims are amended to overcome the rejection under 35 U.S.C. 101. In particular, all of the claims now recite a vehicle. Figures 1-4 show vehicles in various traffic scenarios. Figures 6-8 show vehicle electronics implementing the operations claimed herein. Each independent claim is also amended to state that the first traffic object safety score is used to adjust or affect the behavior of the vehicle. Support for this amendment is found in paragraph [0112] of the application.
A vehicle is not abstract. Furthermore, the functionality of the vehicle is improved by adjusting or affecting behavior of the vehicle in response to the traffic object safety score.

In view of the foregoing, all claims should be in a condition for allowance. If there are any residual matters that can be resolved with a telephone call, the Examiner is requested to contact the undersigned.
The Director is hereby authorized to charge any appropriate fees under 37 C.F.R. §§1.16,

1.17, and 1.21 that may be required by this paper, and to credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 50-1283 referencing Docket No. SYSM-001/02US 337597-2006. However, the Director is not authorized to charge the cost of the issue fee to the Deposit Account.
